text_block_list.text:
It happened during summer camp.
King Halo was also aiming for her goal,
the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Seizing glory in the Kikuka Sho as well!
And the name of that Umamusume is—?

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text: King Halooo!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Yes, my name is none other than—
King Halooo-!!!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No, no, no! Hopeless!
That's where you're supposed to say, 'King is the greatest!'

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Training can wait for now!
First, we need to show the world King's presence!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There are so many tourists here.
I shall make sure as many people as possible remember my name.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you plan on running in the Takarazuka Kinen or Arima Kinen later on,
the fan vote is super important, you know?♪
The logic is certainly sound, but...

text_block_list.name: Stall Tourists in Line
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Is that the rich girl everyone's talking about?
Rich young ladies really just do whatever they want, huh~

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't she just riding on her parents' coattails?
Seriously, I heard her folks are amazing.
My dad was saying so too."

"I feel like this approach might actually backfire.
It'd be better to highlight her natural strength—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...This is fine. This is how it should be.
Because I'm still—

text_block_list.name: Tourists
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!! That's...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
Found you, Sei-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, well, if it isn't Spe-chan.
Running in such a hurry, is something the matter~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, the best fishing spot this time
is over by the rocks further down the coast~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Nope, not fishing today!
I wanted to ask if you'd run alongside me!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I just can't forget Sei-chan's running that I saw at the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, that's pretty direct. As expected of a main-character girl.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Too bad for you, though☆ A slacker Umamusume's
policy is to never show her hand!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah, so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, even I can...!

text_block_list.name: Stall Tourists in Line
text_block_list.text:
"...I really like Special Week's
straightforward, unrelenting grit."

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! Plus, they've got an eye for talent!
Keeping an eye on Seiun Sky and all!

text_block_list.name: Tourist in Swimsuit
text_block_list.text: Ever since the Satsuki Sho, I've had a feeling Seiun Sky would pull off something big too~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: With just a single race, those two already have their names being called out.
choice_data_list: …Do you want to be called by your name too?
...Do you want to be called by your first name too?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, after all, I carry
the name "King Halo".

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Someone's daughter" or whatever
is a title I have no need for... Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
K-Kawakami-san!?
What are you doing here...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? I am a student of Tracen Academy as well, after all.
It should hardly be surprising that I would attend the training camp, no?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's not what I mean! That's precisely
why you need to take your training seriously...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's why! I'm going to train together with King-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. I just heard it a moment ago!
Your declaration that you will conquer the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I want to train with someone strong
who is brimming with confidence in their own victory!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, aren't you
a little too pure for your own good?
choice_data_list: Are you prepared to join in on this hellish call...?
Are you prepared to join in on this hellish call...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, aren't you
a little too pure for your own good?
choice_data_list: Are you prepared to join in on this hellish call...?
Are you prepared to join in on this hellish call...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You know, she isn't my junior.
This girl is—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-san! I'm going on ahead!
And I'm going to win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Hold on!
Who did you say is gonna beat whoooo!?

And so, swept up in Kawakami Princess's
pace, I ended up running alongside her—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*, why did it turn out like this?
Most of the people have left, too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've built up a decent amount of stamina, so I suppose I'll let it slide.
Starting tomorrow, however...
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone what King Halo can do!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph, as long as you understand.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take a stroll before heading back.
You go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why are you trying to make me do that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*G-Gulp*... A roll call from hell...!
So that is what the secret special training entails...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-san? Let me guess, you're the type
who easily gets sweet-talked into buying lucky pots, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Geez, what is it with these people...!
Come on~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fine! If you want it that badly,
I'll grant you the privilege of joining my cheers!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: After I say something, you shout "King Halo!", okay? Got it!? Understood!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yeeees♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *gasp*.
I wonder if this was enough to catch their eye?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, all of you.
Rest your voices to prepare for tomorrow."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Of course, right? Since you joined once,
you have to stay with me until the very end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take a stroll before heading back.
Go on ahead without me... *Phew*. *Inhale*...!

And before I could stop her,
King Halo had already sprinted away.

"Because of the sandy surface, her acceleration was slower than usual,
and yet her legs—"

text_block_list.name: Gentle Old Journalist
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, as expected. She's really not like a mother.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Old Journalist
text_block_list.text:
Ah, apologies. It seems I spoke out loud.
To tell the truth, I used to be a huge fan of her mother...

text_block_list.name: Gentle Old Journalist
text_block_list.text: I heard a rumor that that young lady was running, so I just had to come. Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Old Journalist
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, she puts on quite a good run.
Though with a mother like hers—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... No good.
Why am I... out of breath already...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: "...I haven't been acknowledged yet. That's why I can't let my feet stop... right?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fame, the limelight, even basic interest...
It's still nowhere near enough...!
